description: This Dart source file defines the ReadArticleScreen widget for a Flutter application. It displays a web view of a news article, and provides functionalities such as text-to-speech (TTS) for reading the article aloud, sharing the article, saving it with notifications, and browsing external links. The file imports multiple external packages like flutter_tts, provider, share_plus, url_launcher, and webview_flutter, indicating its role in rendering and interacting with news articles within the app.

classes.name: ReadArticleArgs
classes.description: A simple data class to encapsulate the arguments passed to the ReadArticleScreen, containing a NewsArticle object.

classes.name: ReadArticleScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the screen for reading a news article, integrating web view and TTS features.

classes.name: _ReadArticleScreenState
classes.description: The state class managing the WebViewController, FlutterTts, and UI interactions for ReadArticleScreen.

classes.name: _ListenMenuButton
classes.description: A custom StatelessWidget providing a popup menu for controlling TTS playback, speed, and voice selection.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the TTS engine and WebView controller, loads the article URL.

methods.name: _configureTts
methods.description: Configures the TTS engine with language and speech rate settings.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources by stopping TTS when the widget is disposed.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree, including AppBar with controls and WebView for article content.

methods.name: _handleMoreAction
methods.description: Handles actions from the popup menu: sharing, saving, browsing.

methods.name: _ttsText
methods.description: Generates the text to be spoken by TTS, appending a paywall message.

methods.name: _play
methods.description: Triggers TTS to start speaking the article content.

methods.name: _applyRateAndPlay
methods.description: Sets the speech rate and starts TTS playback.

methods.name: _applyVoiceAndPlay
methods.description: Sets the TTS voice based on selection and starts playback.
